title: Learning a language as an adult
instructions: Wpisz w każdą lukę dokładnie jedno słowo. Skróty typu don't liczą się jako dwa słowa, więc nie są poprawną odpowiedzią. Każda luka to 1 punkt.
text: It is often said that children learn languages more easily {{1}} adults. While there is some truth in this, adults have advantages {{2}} their own. For one thing, they are usually better at understanding grammar rules, {{3}} means they can make faster progress in the early stages. {{4}} is more, adults tend to be more motivated, especially if they need the language for work. The key, according to many teachers, is to practise little and often {{5}} than studying for hours once a week. {{6}} you choose to learn, consistency matters far more {{7}} talent. Even ten minutes a day can make a real difference, as long {{8}} you keep it up.
